**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject non-UTF-8 receipt text before building**

When an otherwise valid `SourceArtifact` contains a lone surrogate in a permitted receipt field such as `source_uri` or a header value, `artifact_value()` accepts it because canonical receipt JSON uses ASCII escaping, and this returns that value as provenance. Candidate ingestion then completes, but manifest publication fails when `atomic_json()` encodes the provenance as strict UTF-8, leaving a retained archive and an unusable candidate directory and causing every retry to rebuild. Validate that the detached receipt can be encoded as manifest UTF-8 before returning it here (or before retention/building begins).
